title: Welcome
narration: Welcome. This experience has been created to help you understand how your banking support will continue after your local branch closure.
You are in control throughout this experience. You can pause, repeat, go back or ask for a colleague to help at any time.
Before we begin, I will help you choose the settings that make this experience most comfortable for you.

title: Choose your support options
narration: Please choose any support options that would make this experience easier for you.
You can select more than one option.
If you would prefer a colleague to help you, please select colleague-assisted mode.

title: Choose a voice
narration: You can choose the voice you would prefer for this experience.
Please select one of the options below.
You can change this setting later if needed.

title: A few short questions
narration: Before I show the banking alternatives, I would like to ask a few short questions.
These questions help us understand whether this experience improves your confidence.
There are no right or wrong answers.

title: Question 1 of 5
narration: How concerned do you feel about your local branch closing?

scales.prompt: How concerned do you feel about your local branch closing?

title: Question 2 of 5
narration: How confident are you that you know where to go for banking after the branch closes?

scales.prompt: How confident are you that you know where to go for banking after the branch closes?

title: Question 3 of 5
narration: How confident are you using mobile banking?

scales.prompt: How confident are you using mobile banking?

title: Question 4 of 5
narration: How often do you currently use mobile banking?

title: Question 5 of 5
narration: Which type of support would you prefer today?

title: Thank you
narration: Thank you. I will use your answers to make this experience more relevant to you.
At the end, I will ask a few of these questions again so we can see whether this journey helped.

title: Hello [Customer Name]
narration: Hello [Customer Name], welcome.
We understand that your local branch, [Branch Name], is closing.
We know this may change the way you usually bank with us, and we want to help you understand what support will still be available.
This experience will show nearby banking alternatives, what services are available, how far they are, what you may need to bring and who can help you.

title: How you usually bank
narration: Based on your usual banking pattern, you may need support with services such as cash withdrawal, cheque deposit, balance enquiry, account support or face-to-face help.

Today, I will show how these needs can continue through nearby options such as a Banking Hub, Post Office, Community Banker, alternative branch, cash machine, mobile banking and dedicated support channels.

title: Take your time
narration: You do not need to decide everything now.
This experience is here to help you understand your options step by step.
If anything feels unclear, you can ask for colleague help at any point.

title: Is there anything you are worried about?
narration: Before we continue, would you like to share any concerns or reactions about the branch closure?
You can select from the options, or skip this step.

choices.label: I am worried about travelling further
I do not feel confident using mobile banking
I need help from a person
I need privacy for my banking
I am not sure what services are available elsewhere

title: Thank you for telling me
narration: I will now shape the experience around this need.
You can change or add concerns later.

responses.travel: Thank you for sharing that. I will prioritise nearby options, distance, travel choices and whether the place offers the service you need.
responses.cash: Thank you. I will show cash access options first, including cash machines, Banking Hubs, Post Offices and other cash services where available.
responses.digital: Thank you. Later in this experience, I will show a safe practice version of mobile banking. No real account details or real money will be used.
responses.human: Thank you. I will make sure the journey shows where you can speak to a person, including branch colleagues, Community Bankers and support lines.
responses.accessibility: Thank you. I will keep accessibility support visible throughout the journey, including seating, subtitles, private space, low-motion mode and colleague assistance.
responses.privacy: Thank you. I will show where private conversations may be available, and I will avoid showing sensitive details on shared screens.
responses.unsure: Thank you. I will show what each nearby option can and cannot do, so you know before you travel.

title: We can pause here
narration: We can pause here.
You do not need to continue right now.
A colleague can support you if you would like.
You may take a seat, have some water and continue only when you are ready.

title: Where banking can continue
narration: Now I will show how banking support can continue after your branch closes.
Instead of starting with a transaction, I will first show the different places and channels available to you.
You can then choose which option you want to explore in more detail.

title: Your nearby options
narration: These are the options available near you: a Banking Hub, the Post Office, a Community Banker, an alternative branch, a cash machine or Talking ATM, a Community Cash In and Out machine, PayPoint, mobile banking, and a dedicated helpline.
A map of these locations will appear here.

title: Nearest is not always best
narration: These options are shown based on your branch location, registered address or selected postcode.
Some options may be closer, while others may provide more support.
The nearest option is not always the best option, so I will also show service availability, support type, accessibility and opening times.

title: What would you like to see?
narration: Which option would you like to explore?

choices.label: I have seen enough — show my summary
Ask a colleague to help me choose

title: Welcome to the Banking Hub
narration: Welcome to the Banking Hub.
This is one of the places where banking support may continue after your local branch closes.
I will show the layout, services, opening times, support areas and what you can do here.

title: [Hub Name]
narration: [Hub Name] is at [Hub Address], [Hub Distance] away — [Hub Travel Time].
It is open [Hub Opening Times].
On this screen, you can see the distance, opening times and travel options.
You can also see which services may be available here.
Services may include everyday banking support, cash services, cheque services, balance enquiries and access to Community Bankers on selected days.

title: The entrance and seating area
narration: This is the entrance area.
If you need time before speaking to someone, you can use the seating area.
If you feel unsure, you can ask a colleague where to go.

title: The main counter
narration: This is the main counter.
You can come here for everyday banking support.
For example, you may ask about cash withdrawal, cash deposit, cheque deposit or balance enquiry.
If you are unsure what to ask, you can simply say: I need help with my banking today.

choices.label: How do I pay in a cheque?

title: Paying in a cheque
narration: If you need to deposit a cheque, bring the cheque and any required account or card details.
At the counter, you can say: I would like to pay in this cheque.
The colleague will confirm whether this service is available for your bank at this location.
If the service is available, keep any receipt or confirmation given to you.

title: Cash services
narration: If you need cash, the counter may be able to help with cash withdrawal or cash deposit.
For some business customers, change services may also be available.
Availability can depend on the bank, account type and local service arrangement.

title: The private room
narration: This is the private room.
You can ask to use this space if your conversation is personal, sensitive or more complex.
Examples include financial difficulty, bereavement, Power of Attorney, carer support, accessibility needs or account concerns.
You can say: I would like to speak privately about my account.

title: Community Banker area
narration: Community Bankers may be available on selected days.
At [Hub Name], your bank's Community Banker is usually here on [Community Banker Days].
They can help with bank-specific questions and more detailed account support.
When you arrive, ask: When is my bank's Community Banker available?
If your bank is not available today, you can return on the correct day or use another support route.

title: You have seen the Banking Hub
narration: You have now seen the Banking Hub layout.
You know where the counter is, where seating is available, where private conversations may happen, and where to ask about Community Banker support.
Would you like to continue to the Post Office option, mobile banking practice, or see your summary?

title: The Post Office
narration: This is the Post Office banking counter journey.
In some locations, customers can use the Post Office for selected everyday banking services.
I will show what to expect before you visit.

title: What you can do here
narration: This service board shows the banking activities that may be available here.
These can include cash withdrawal, cash deposit, cheque deposit and balance enquiry, depending on your bank and the local service arrangement.
Before travelling, check whether the service you need is available.

title: The queue and counter
narration: When you arrive, join the queue for the counter.
Have your bank card, cheque, cash or account details ready, depending on the service you need.
When it is your turn, tell the colleague what you would like to do.

choices.label: How do I pay in cash?
How do I check my balance?

title: Paying in cash
narration: For cash deposit, you can say: I would like to pay cash into my account.
The colleague will confirm whether the service is available for your bank.
If the deposit is accepted, keep the receipt.

title: Checking your balance
narration: For balance enquiry, you can say: Can I check my account balance please?
The colleague may ask for your card or account details.
If the service cannot be completed here, use the next available option shown in your summary.

title: You have seen the Post Office
narration: You have now seen the Post Office banking journey.
This option may be useful for everyday banking, but it may not support every service.
If your need is more complex, a Banking Hub, Community Banker, branch colleague or specialist support route may be more suitable.

title: A practice mobile screen
narration: You have seen some physical options.
Now I will show which services may also be available through mobile banking.
This is a practice screen. No real account is connected. No real money will move.

title: What a banking app shows
narration: This large mobile screen shows a practice version of mobile banking.
In a real app, you may be able to check your balance, view recent transactions, find statements, manage alerts and ask for help.
If something is difficult, support routes such as chat, live chat and phone help may be available.

title: About security checks
narration: Some digital banking tasks require security checks.
This practice screen will explain where security checks may appear, but it will not ask for your password, PIN, passcode or security answers.
Never share those details inside this experience or with anyone else.

title: Practice: check a balance
narration: Let us practise checking a balance.
First, select the account tile.
The available balance is usually shown near the top of the account screen.
You can also look for recent transactions below.
No real account information is shown here.

title: Practice: find a statement
narration: Now let us practise finding statements.
Look for the section called statements, documents or account information.
Select the statement option.
In the real app, this may show previous statements or documents.

title: Practice: find help
narration: Now I will show where help can be found.
Select the help or support button.
You may see options such as chat, live chat, phone support or help articles.
A digital assistant may answer simple questions first.
If the question needs more help, you may be connected to a person.

title: A dedicated support route
narration: For customers affected by branch closure, a dedicated support route can be shown here.
This route helps customers who still need reassurance, practical guidance or human support.
You are not expected to manage everything alone.

title: How does that feel?
narration: After seeing this practice screen, how confident do you feel using mobile banking for simple tasks?

scales.prompt: How confident do you feel using mobile banking for simple tasks?

title: Ways to speak to a person
narration: You have several ways to get human support: a branch colleague, the Banking Hub counter, a Community Banker, the Post Office counter, mobile app chat, live chat with a person, phone support, a dedicated branch-closure helpline, and specialist vulnerable-customer support.
If your need is simple, a counter colleague may help.
If your need is bank-specific or more detailed, a Community Banker or branch colleague may be more suitable.
If you need help from home, you may use chat, live chat, phone support or a dedicated branch-closure support route.

title: If your need is personal
narration: Some needs are personal or sensitive.
These may include bereavement, financial difficulty, Power of Attorney, carer support, illness, accessibility needs or financial abuse.
For these needs, the experience will direct you to a private or specialist support route.

title: Asking to speak privately
narration: If you need to speak privately, you can say: I need to discuss something privately about my account.
A colleague can help you find the right support route.
You do not need to explain sensitive details in this experience.

title: Almost finished
narration: You have completed the main experience.
I will now ask a few of the same questions again.
This helps us understand whether the experience improved your confidence.

title: Question 1 of 5
narration: How concerned do you feel now about your local branch closing?

scales.prompt: How concerned do you feel now about your local branch closing?

title: Question 2 of 5
narration: How confident are you now that you know where to go after the branch closes?

scales.prompt: How confident are you now that you know where to go after the branch closes?

title: Question 3 of 5
narration: How confident are you now using mobile banking for simple tasks?

scales.prompt: How confident are you now using mobile banking for simple tasks?

title: Question 4 of 5
narration: Do you understand which services may be available at a Banking Hub, Post Office or through mobile banking?

title: Question 5 of 5
narration: Would you still like help from a colleague?

title: Thank you
narration: Thank you. Your answers help show whether this experience improved understanding and confidence.
You can now save a summary, ask for colleague help or provide feedback.

title: What else would help?
narration: Before you finish, please tell us what else would make this experience more helpful.
You can choose an option, or skip this step.

title: What would you like more of?
narration: Please choose whatever would have helped you most.

choices.label: More detail about Post Office services

title: Thank you
narration: Thank you for using the Branch Closure Confidence Navigator.
Your summary is ready.
It shows your selected options, where to go, what to bring, what can be done digitally and who can help.

title: Your summary
narration: This is your final summary.
You can use this to remember your next step after the branch closes.

title: Before you go
narration: If anything is unclear, please select colleague help before you leave.
You can save, print, send or ask a colleague to review this summary with you.
